events.name: 2026 Iran War — Strait of Hormuz Crisis
events.description: Active Iran-US-Israel war. Ceasefire declared but Strait of Hormuz not fully reopened. Iran-Oman deal close but not finalized as of Aug 6. Houthi attack on Saudi oil tanker Aug 5. Iran drafting bill to regulate Hormuz traffic with restrictions.

events.name: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — WHO PHEIC
events.description: WHO declared PHEIC on May 16, 2026. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. 3,874 confirmed cases, 1,751 deaths as of Aug 4. Bundibugyo strain — no approved vaccine. Cases in 5 DRC provinces plus Uganda. Africa CDC and WHO calling for urgent community-led action.

events.name: Russia Banking Crisis Risk — Systemic
events.description: Sber (Russia's largest bank) reporting rapid NPL deterioration H1 2026. Bankruptcies up 13.7% YoY. Kremlin-linked think tank (CMASF) warns systemic banking crisis possible by October 2026 if problem assets continue rising. Stagflation risk elevated.

events.name: Unprecedented Japan-South Korea-US Joint FX Intervention
events.description: First-ever trilateral coordinated currency intervention on July 31, 2026. Japan and South Korea bought their currencies in open market, possibly alongside the US. Won hit 9-month high. Signals deep concern about currency instability.

notable_non_cat5.name: Brazil-Argentina Diplomatic Crisis
notable_non_cat5.description: Brazil withdrew ambassador from Argentina after Milei insulted Lula. Diplomatic ties downgraded. Threatens bilateral trade relationship.

notable_non_cat5.name: Fed Holds Rates, Hawks Vocal
notable_non_cat5.description: Fed kept rates at 3.5-3.75% on July 29. Three votes for increase. 30Y Treasury yield at highest since 2007. Chair Warsh says will not hesitate to act if inflation accelerates.

notable_non_cat5.name: Gold at $4,242 — Safe Haven Demand Strong
notable_non_cat5.description: Gold down from $5,597 peak (Jan 2026) but still historically extreme. Record Q1 demand $193bn. Driven by Iran war + Ebola uncertainty.
